full_prompt_en: The square image is a coarse graphic portrait of a middle-aged man, shown in profile against a flat field of saturated red and orange. His head occupies the upper-left and centre, turned toward the right side of the frame. The crown is nearly bald, with a short fringe of grey hair visible along the back and lower edge of the scalp. His forehead slopes toward a prominent nose, and one eye is lowered toward the hand held beneath his mouth. A thick dark brow, deep eye socket, moustache and close beard are described with rough charcoal and grey strokes. His hand rises from the lower centre and rests against his chin; bent fingers partly cover the lower beard, making the pose read as thoughtful and inward-looking. The face and hand are assembled from pale grey, muted beige, charcoal and occasional warm brown patches, with scratched marks and crosshatched lines breaking up the forms. A vivid red-orange garment fills the shoulder and chest area below the jaw. Its broad angular folds merge into darker brown and black shapes near the bottom, while an orange-red contour separates the body from the background. Behind him, a large vermilion-red field covers most of the upper and left background. A flat orange rectangular area extends across the lower right, with a narrow band of deeper red near the bottom edge. These simple colour blocks leave ample empty space around the head and emphasize its right-facing profile. The image has no visible setting or additional objects. The light is subdued and frontal, bringing a few pale planes forward across the scalp, brow, cheek and knuckles while leaving the eye, beard and neck in deep shadow. Edges alternate between hard geometric cuts and rough, broken brushwork. The raised forearm and hand form a compact diagonal beneath the face, drawing the eye from the orange garment toward the chin. Individual fingers are partly obscured by the beard, yet their curled arrangement remains visible against the darker neck and clothing. The scalp catches a few pale grey marks, while the ear, temple and rear of the head fall into cooler shadow. The red background is largely unmodulated, making its clean expanses contrast with the worked, granular marks on the figure. No text, furniture or surrounding setting is visible; the picture is built from the single profile, its hand, garment and flat colour blocks. The overall composition places the man off-centre against emphatic red-orange shapes, combining a quiet thinking gesture with stark colour and a heavily worked surface.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、粗粝而具有图形感的男子肖像，人物以侧面呈现，身后是饱和的红色与橙色平涂背景。他的头部占据左上方至中央区域，朝向画面右侧。头顶几乎秃发，后脑和头皮下缘可见一圈短短的灰发。他的额头向突出的鼻梁倾斜，一只眼睛垂向嘴下方的手。浓重的深色眉毛、凹陷眼窝、上唇胡和贴面短须以粗糙的炭灰与灰色笔触刻画。手从下方中央抬起，抵住下巴；弯曲的手指部分遮住下颌胡须，使姿态显得沉思而内敛。面部和手部由浅灰、低饱和米色、炭黑与少量暖棕色块拼成，刮擦痕和交叉排线打断形体的平滑过渡。下颌以下，鲜明的红橙色衣服覆盖肩部与胸前。宽大的棱角褶皱在接近底部处融入更深的棕黑色形块，衣服外缘则以一道橙红色线条和背景分开。人物身后，大面积朱红色铺在上方与左侧。一块平涂橙色矩形从右下方横向延伸，底边附近还有一道较窄的深红色带。这些简洁色块在头部周围留下宽阔空处，突出朝右的侧脸。画面中看不到明确场景或其他物件。光线从正面含蓄照来，在头皮、眉骨、面颊与指节上带出几处浅色平面，同时让眼睛、胡须和颈部沉入深影。边缘在硬朗的几何切面与粗粝断续的笔触之间交替。抬起的前臂与手在脸下方形成紧凑的斜线，将视线从橙色衣服引向下巴。胡须遮住部分手指，但手指弯曲的排列仍能在较暗的颈部和衣料前辨认。头皮上有几道浅灰色痕迹，耳朵、太阳穴和后脑则落入较冷的阴影。红色背景大体平整无变化，因此干净的色面与人物身上反复刻画、略带颗粒感的痕迹形成对照。画面中看不到文字、家具或周围环境；构成内容只有侧面人物、手、衣服和平涂色块。整体构图将男子偏置于红橙色块前，以安静的思索姿态、鲜明色彩和反复处理的表面共同形成强烈画面。
style_prompt_en: The image uses a coarse graphic language in which forms are assembled from angular patches rather than smooth transitions. Scratched lines, crosshatching and rough blocks leave the surface visibly worked, while dark contours cut across lighter planes. Saturated vermilion and orange occupy broad, flat areas beside charcoal, cool grey and muted ochre, making warm-cool contrast the main organizing force. Light is direct but subdued, so pale planes emerge clearly while shadows remain dense and graphic. Background shapes stay simple and rectangular, giving the composition a compressed, poster-like structure. The overall effect is stark and tense, driven by rough texture, cropped masses and emphatic colour.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用粗粝的图形语言，形体由棱角分明的色块拼合，而非平滑过渡。刮擦线条、交叉排线和粗糙块面留下明显的手工痕迹，深色轮廓穿过浅色平面。大片饱和朱红与橙色并置炭黑、冷灰和低饱和赭色，使冷暖对比成为组织画面的主要力量。光线直接但含蓄，因此浅色平面清晰突出，阴影则保持浓重而图形化。背景形状简洁偏矩形，使构图显得压缩并带有海报感。整体效果鲜明而紧张，依靠粗糙肌理、裁切的大形与强调色彩建立。
